collection.title: Rover 400 1996 to 1999 Windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: The Rover 400 Mk2 1996 to 1999 model requires a 18" wiper blade on both the drivers side and the passengers side, all of the following wiper blades are designed to fit this vehicle. The type of wiper arm fitting for this model is the Standard Hook arm attachment. There is the option of upgrading to the newer Retrofit style wiper blade, we also have rear blade for this Rover 400, simply click on the Rear Blades tab below.
